scope: Exact historical replay. DCP identities are preregistered provenance. Replay reads RAW and TIFF; it matches full XMP fingerprints and does not reread the three reference DCPs or SDK ZIP.

source.lines: 28-44 (old fall-through and Build 2768 zero canonicalization), 69 (nonzero fixed-denominator path)

fingerprint_amendment.unchanged: Every III digest expectation, the required Q7 profile name and source SHA, all TIFF/XMP/WB gates, all geometry/masks, every metric. Observed matching selects a declared fingerprint serialization; it does not identify the Lightroom source revision.

dcp_source.basename: PENTAX K-3 Mark III Adobe Standard.dcp
PENTAX K-3 Mark III Camera Bright.dcp

metadata_policy.strict: Exact name and full SDK-derived digest; all other CRS attributes and six nested elements exact.
metadata_policy.secondary: Only existing Temperature/Tint may change, with native UI evidence of automatic readout under As Shot and no manual WB changes. All other controls exact. Descriptive profile + As Shot interpretation.
metadata_policy.container_only_drift: TIFF bytes/size, pixel SHA, XML packet bytes and non-CRS metadata can differ. Require exact TIFF shape/type/header/model/software/ICC and exact CRS; capture actual byte, pixel and XMP hashes. No Version/ProcessVersion/exposure/crop/lens or unknown CRS drift.

mask_policy: Replay pinned baseline geometry and used masks. Repeat Studio30 matching independently for each metadata-admitted profile; no sites selected. Each scene uses one intersection on the fixed JPEG grid across the baseline and ALL prescribed variants, with every participant passing the local/gradient/clipping gate. No reduced-profile fallback if any export is absent or ineligible. Retain regions with at least 128 intersected pixels and require at least six regions. Preserve global fit/holdout results and label any local-only contributor. Apply identical mask to every comparison and keep all failures.

aggregation.bin_rules: JPEG Lab only. L uses left-closed/right-open bins except final L includes exactly 100; C uses left-closed/right-open, null=positive infinity. Any out-of-range L is counted as unbinned and still appears in unbinned full-set statistics.
aggregation.pixel_weighted: Pool all paired masked pixels of a scene or bin; report median signed L*/a*/b*/C*, median and p90 delta E00.
aggregation.equal_region: Calculate the same six statistics separately within each region, then report their unweighted arithmetic means over contributing regions. In bins a region contributes when it has at least one pixel in the bin. Preserve per-bin sample and contributing-region counts. Empty bins have no estimate.

method.method: Existing LittleCMS tificc: JPEG sRGB, TIFF embedded ProPhoto, D50 Lab relative colorimetric with BPC off, RGB16 bilinear sampling before conversion; existing CIEDE2000. Score only after geometry for all groups is checked.
method.per_group: Per profile vs camera Bright JPEG with original regional/pixel/bin metrics; each new profile vs matrix baseline on same pixels; paired change in per-pixel CIEDE2000 to JPEG (candidate minus matrix), median and p90, per-region median and arithmetic mean of regional medians. Negative paired change is closer on that pixel.
method.interpretation: Descriptive scene residuals, not perceptual equivalence or calibration. Same-image profiles change several DCP components together. Numeric WB equality is observable metadata, not proof of equal internal channel gains. No post-hoc threshold, rescaling, fitting or re-rendering to normalize.

witness_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(',',':'), no trailing newline. Integer object keys are strings after JSON round trip.
